title: The restricted regular coefficient comparison and the exact pullback counit
statement: For a morphism a:Λ→Λ′ of commutative condensed rings and a scheme morphism f:X→Y, let F be ordinary Λ-module pullback. Let e:F(B₀(a,Y))≅B₀(a,X) be the ordinary restricted regular pullback comparison of [new-integral-residue-ordinary-tensor-square], and let eH be the composite of F.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors with its single-complex comparison and single.mapIso e. Then scalarTensorRegularPullIso(a,f).inv followed by L_Λ(f) applied to tensorModelCoefficientIso(B₀(a,Y)).hom and the exact pullback counit at tensorModelCoefficient(B₀(a,Y)) equals tensorModelCoefficientIso(B₀(a,X)).hom followed by Qh.map(eH.inv). The coefficient objects and the derived comparison are those of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons] and [def-sfb-internal-scalar-tensor-pull-models]. No variable complex or normalized scalar base-change isomorphism enters this equation.

proof.text: Identify scalarTensorRegularRestriction with the exact restriction/singleFunctor comparison. Expand scalarTensorRegularPullIso, use the exact pullback unit comparison, and commute the exact restriction/pullback comparison on single objects. Naturality cancels the Y restriction/single comparison. This leaves F.singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedFunctorIso followed by single.mapIso of the ordinary restricted unit.

The ordinary native pullback unit equals the transported unit by functoriality on the identity of the regular module. Thus this coefficient isomorphism uses exactly e. Apply tensorModelCoefficientIso_counit with F and e.

theorem scalar_regular_pull_counit (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    let F := CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f
    let e := CondensedRing.residueOrdinaryRestrictedRegularPullIso Λ Λ' a f
    let eH := (F.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).app
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (B₀ a Y)) ≪≫
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).mapIso
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app (B₀ a Y) ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso e)
    (scalarTensorRegularPullIso a f).inv ≫
      (L Λ f).map (Functor.tensorModelCoefficientIso (B₀ a Y)).hom ≫
      (pullCounit (Λ := Λ) f).app (Functor.tensorModelCoefficient (B₀ a Y)) =
      (Functor.tensorModelCoefficientIso (B₀ a X)).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map eH.inv
